column1: # Which of the eight formal roots a corpus colour speaks for, for the colours
# that can carry a theme's identity: a ground (role deep or base) names the
# dominant root, an accent (role accent) names the accent root. A palette
# made from a picture (vivac theme from-image) reads its two roots here and
# then the distance between them in root-distance.tsv, exactly as a
# The eight shipped themes are the anchors: each one's ground and accent are
# filed under the roots that theme already declares (test_theme_from_image.sh
# and ThemeFromImage.Tests.ps1 hold that line). The rest follow the family
# their pack belongs to: night blues and violets are Luna, burgundy and wine
# Fuego, rose and coral Flor, golds and ambers Sol, greens and teals Tierra,
# greys, khaki and dark olive Piedra. Montana and Champinon have no colour of
# their own in the corpus yet, so nothing is filed under them.
# basis: anchor, a colour one of the eight shipped themes uses, so its root is
# the one that theme declares; family, filed by its pack's colour family and
# open to review. The readers take the first two columns.
